summary: Stevanato Group S.p.A. furnished a Form 6-K attaching an earnings press release dated November 3, 2026, reporting third-quarter fiscal 2026 results: revenue rose 8% (8% organic) to EUR 326.1 million, adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 150 basis points to 27.2%, and diluted EPS grew 15% to EUR 0.15 (adjusted EUR 0.16). Management maintained full-year 2026 guidance of EUR 1.260-1.280 billion revenue, EUR 335.0-345.2 million adjusted EBITDA, and EUR 0.60-0.62 adjusted diluted EPS, while flagging lower expected GLP-1 volumes ahead. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly earnings report and does not constitute a special situation.
